ast.name: error
ast.source: language cannot contain newlines or backticks
ast.target: 語言名稱不可包含換行或反引號

ast.name: error
ast.source: requires a property path or arrow function (e.g., map:"name")
ast.target: 需要屬性路徑或箭頭函式（例如 map:"name"）

ast.name: error
ast.source: accepts at most a property and direction
ast.target: 最多接受屬性與排序方向兩個參數

ast.name: error
ast.source: accepts at most one property path
ast.target: 最多接受一個屬性路徑

ast.name: error
ast.source: accepts at most a limit and suffix
ast.target: 最多接受長度上限與後綴兩個參數

ast.name: error
ast.source: limit must be a non-negative integer
ast.target: 長度上限必須是非負整數

ast.name: error
ast.source: accepts only "flow"; omit the parameter for block YAML
ast.target: 僅接受 "flow"；使用區塊式 YAML 時請省略此參數

ast.name: error
ast.source: requires a property path and value
ast.target: 需要屬性路徑與值

ast.name: error
ast.source: requires exactly a property path and value
ast.target: 必須提供屬性路徑與值兩個參數

ast.name: message
ast.source: Unclosed comment - missing '#}'
ast.target: 註解未關閉，缺少「#}」

ast.name: message
ast.source: Expected a property name after .
ast.target: 「.」後方應接屬性名稱

ast.name: error
ast.source: An object-reference stream header is invalid or exceeds the object limit.
ast.target: 物件參照串流標頭無效，或超過物件數量限制。

ast.name: error
ast.source: The nested property-set depth limit was exceeded.
ast.target: 巢狀屬性集的深度超過限制。

ast.name: error
ast.source: The property count exceeds the configured per-object limit.
ast.target: 屬性數量超過每個物件的設定限制。

ast.name: error
ast.source: A length-prefixed property value is too large.
ast.target: 含長度前綴的屬性值過大。

ast.name: error
ast.source: A property reference count exceeds the configured object limit.
ast.target: 屬性參照數量超過物件數量限制。

ast.name: error
ast.source: A property reference uses a missing global-identification table entry.
ast.target: 屬性參照使用了全域識別表中不存在的項目。

ast.name: error
ast.source: The object data ended inside a property set.
ast.target: 物件資料在屬性集內提前結束。

ast.name: message
ast.source: The source contains trailing bytes beyond the file length declared by its revision-store header.
ast.target: 來源在版本儲存標頭所宣告的檔案長度之後仍含有多餘位元組。

ast.name: error
ast.source: requires an operation (e.g., calc:"+10", calc:"*2")
ast.target: 需要指定運算（例如 calc:"+10"、calc:"*2"）

ast.name: error
ast.source: requires a number after the operator (e.g., "+10")
ast.target: 運算子後需接數字（例如 "+10"）

ast.name: error
ast.source: requires a modifier (e.g., date_modify:"+1 day", "-2 weeks")
ast.target: 需要指定調整值（例如 date_modify:"+1 day"、"-2 weeks"）

ast.name: error
ast.source: invalid format. Use "+1 day", "-2 weeks", etc.
ast.target: 格式無效。請使用 "+1 day"、"-2 weeks" 等格式。

ast.name: error
ast.source: positions must be positive numbers (e.g., nth:1,2,3:7)
ast.target: 位置必須是正整數（例如 nth:1,2,3:7）

ast.name: error
ast.source: basis must be a positive number (e.g., nth:1,2,3:7)
ast.target: 基數必須是正整數（例如 nth:1,2,3:7）

ast.name: error
ast.source: invalid syntax. Use number (2), multiplier (5n), offset (n+7), or basis (1,2:5)
ast.target: 語法無效。請使用數字（2）、倍數（5n）、位移（n+7）或基數（1,2:5）

ast.name: error
ast.source: requires a parameter: "array", "keys", or "values"
ast.target: 需要參數："array"、"keys" 或 "values"

ast.name: error
ast.source: values must be quoted (e.g., replace:"old":"new" or replace:"text":"")
ast.target: 值必須加上引號（例如 replace:"old":"new" 或 replace:"text":""）

ast.name: error
ast.source: decimal places must be a number (e.g., round:2)
ast.target: 小數位數必須是數字（例如 round:2）

ast.name: error
ast.source: decimal places must be non-negative (e.g., round:2)
ast.target: 小數位數不可為負數（例如 round:2）

ast.name: error
ast.source: requires at least a start index (e.g., slice:0,5)
ast.target: 至少需要起始索引（例如 slice:0,5）

ast.name: error
ast.source: accepts at most 2 parameters: start and end
ast.target: 最多接受 2 個參數：起始與結束索引

ast.name: message
ast.source: Malformed variable: expected '}}' but found '}'. Did you forget a '}'?
ast.target: 變數格式錯誤：預期為「}}」，但找到「}」。是否少了一個「}」？

ast.name: message
ast.source: Missing closing '}}' for variable
ast.target: 變數缺少結尾的「}}」

ast.name: message
ast.source: Malformed tag: expected '%}' but found '}'. Did you forget the '%'?
ast.target: 標籤格式錯誤：預期為「%}」，但找到「}」。是否少了「%」？

ast.name: message
ast.source: Missing closing '%}' for tag
ast.target: 標籤缺少結尾的「%}」

ast.name: message
ast.source: Unclosed '[' in selector - missing ']'
ast.target: 選取器中的「[」未關閉，缺少「]」

ast.name: message
ast.source: Unclosed '(' in selector - missing ')'
ast.target: 選取器中的「(」未關閉，缺少「)」

ast.name: message
ast.source: Extra ']' in selector - no matching '['
ast.target: 選取器中有多餘的「]」，找不到對應的「[」

ast.name: message
ast.source: Extra ')' in selector - no matching '('
ast.target: 選取器中有多餘的「)」，找不到對應的「(」

ast.name: message
ast.source: Empty variable - add a variable name between {{ and }}
ast.target: 變數不可為空，請在 {{ 與 }} 之間加入變數名稱

ast.name: message
ast.source: Missing closing }}
ast.target: 缺少結尾的 }}

ast.name: message
ast.source: {% if %} requires a condition
ast.target: {% if %} 需要條件

ast.name: message
ast.source: Missing %} to close {% if %}
ast.target: 缺少用來結束 {% if %} 的 %}

ast.name: message
ast.source: {% elseif %} requires a condition
ast.target: {% elseif %} 需要條件

ast.name: message
ast.source: Missing {% endif %} to close {% if %}
ast.target: 缺少用來結束 {% if %} 的 {% endif %}

ast.name: message
ast.source: {% for %} requires something to loop over after "in"
ast.target: {% for %} 的 "in" 後方需要可供迭代的內容

ast.name: message
ast.source: Missing %} to close {% for %}
ast.target: 缺少用來結束 {% for %} 的 %}

ast.name: message
ast.source: Missing {% endfor %} to close {% for %}
ast.target: 缺少用來結束 {% for %} 的 {% endfor %}

ast.name: message
ast.source: {% set %} requires a variable name, e.g. {% set name = value %}
ast.target: {% set %} 需要變數名稱，例如 {% set name = value %}

ast.name: message
ast.source: {% set %} requires "=" after variable name
ast.target: {% set %} 的變數名稱後方需要 "="

ast.name: message
ast.source: {% set %} requires a value after "="
ast.target: {% set %} 的 "=" 後方需要值

ast.name: message
ast.source: Missing %} to close {% set %}
ast.target: 缺少用來結束 {% set %} 的 %}

ast.name: message
ast.source: Missing fallback value after ??
ast.target: ?? 後方缺少備用值

ast.name: message
ast.source: Missing filter name after |
ast.target: | 後方缺少篩選器名稱

ast.name: message
ast.source: Missing value after "or"
ast.target: "or" 後方缺少值

ast.name: message
ast.source: Missing value after "and"
ast.target: "and" 後方缺少值

ast.name: message
ast.source: Missing value after "not"
ast.target: "not" 後方缺少值

ast.name: message
ast.source: Empty brackets [] - add an index or key
ast.target: 方括號 [] 不可為空，請加入索引或鍵名

ast.name: message
ast.source: Missing closing ]
ast.target: 缺少結尾的 ]

ast.name: message
ast.source: Missing closing )
ast.target: 缺少結尾的 )

ast.name: message
ast.source: Empty parentheses () - add an expression
ast.target: 括號 () 不可為空，請加入運算式

ast.name: message
ast.source: Missing closing %}
ast.target: 缺少結尾的 %}

ast.target: 運算不可為空
